values: After successful LinkedIn outreach, update lead status to 'Working - Contacted' and add outreach details to lead description.
Do NOT send LinkedIn outreach. Update lead status to 'Working - Compliance Hold'. Add 'Pending compliance review' to lead description.
Do NOT send LinkedIn outreach. Route to government sales team.
Do NOT send cold LinkedIn outreach. Find existing contact at the company first.
